Mixed purées

White bean purée

Babpüré

6 months+ Adjusted 75 min 4 portions

Blend until smooth. There should be no firm core in a bean.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 120 g dry dried white beans (or 240 g unsalted canned beans, rinsed)
  • 120 g carrot (peeled weight)
  • 2 tsp olive oil (stirred in at the end)
  • as needed to boil water (no salt)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. If using dried beans, soak them, drain them, and boil in fresh water at a rolling boil until completely soft, often 45 to 90 minutes, with no firm centre.
  2. If using canned beans, choose unsalted ones, rinse them, and heat them through.
  3. Peel the carrot and cook it until soft.
  4. Blend beans and carrot with a little cooking water until smooth.
  5. Stir in the olive oil.
  6. Do not add salt.

Adjusted

Undercooked dried beans can make a child ill. Canned beans are often salted.

Boil dried beans hard until they are completely soft, or rinse unsalted canned beans and heat them. Blend with cooked carrot and olive oil, and do not add salt.
